clips.title: The story
paras: Bladefist Bay opens onto the Great Sea along eastern Durotar, just beyond Orgrimmar's gates. Craggy bluffs rise above its shore, with Azshara's southern coast across the water.

Bladefist Bay meets the Great Sea along Durotar's northeastern edge. Rocky cliffs rise above its treacherous surf, just east of Orgrimmar, the Horde capital. Across the water to the north, Azshara's ancient red cliffs and ruins mark the far shore. The bay forms a boundary between Durotar and the open sea.

Kargath Bladefist gave the bay its name. Chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan, he severed his own hand and replaced it with a blade during the old Horde's trials on Draenor. Skull Rock lies nearby, where cultists and hidden rogue networks work in the shadows. The coast recalls the fierce, ruthless legacy of the clan's chieftain.
